angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 332,753 km at 140.61 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.1121 +/- 0.0236 mas (same row, RUWE 1.07): 140.61 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.4783 +/- 0.006 solar radii from Bakos et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HATS-71 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..267B/abstract): 332,753 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.4861 +/- 0.006 solar masses from Bakos et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HATS-71 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..267B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3405 +/- 10 K from Bakos et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HATS-71 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..267B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Bakos et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HATS-71 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..267B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hats-71.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.765, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HATS-71 (pscomppars): spectral type M3 V, from Bakos et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..267B/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HATS-71: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HATS-71 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.17 dex, from Bakos et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..267B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HATS-71 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.55988, from Bakos et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..267B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HATS-71 (pscomppars): age 3.2 Gyr, from Bakos et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..267B/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HATS-71 (pscomppars): rotation period 41.72 d, from Bakos et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..267B/abstract)
